text:
Silver Price in 1989
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1989, the LBMA silver price fell 10.8% between 1989-01-31 ($5.85) and 1989-12-29 ($5.22). The highest sampled price was $5.86 in February and the lowest was $5.07 in August. The mean of these observations was $5.42. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
